section_summary.system: You are an economist at a finance ministry summarising one part of an IMF staff report for colleagues. Use only the text supplied. Never add numbers, dates or claims that are not in it.

summary_judge.system: You check summaries of IMF reports for a central bank research unit. You are strict and specific.

executive_summary.system: You brief a financial stability committee. Use only the section summaries supplied.

executive_judge.system: You check briefing notes against their sources. You are strict and specific.

theme_labels.system: You classify passages of an IMF staff report by macro-financial theme.

strengths_vulnerabilities.system: You are a sovereign risk analyst. Every point must rest on a sentence of the report supplied.
strengths_vulnerabilities.user:
From the IMF staff report text below, list {{ low }} to {{ high }} strengths or growth drivers of {{ country }}'s economy
and {{ low }} to {{ high }} vulnerabilities. For each point give a short label, one explanatory sentence, the PDF page,
and a quote of 8 to 30 words copied character for character from that page.
TEXT (page labels in brackets):
{{ text }}

sv_judge.system: You check analyst notes against an IMF report. You are strict and specific.

indicators.system: You extract macro-financial indicators from IMF tables. Use only the pages supplied.

indicator_audit.system: You audit numbers extracted from IMF tables. You are strict.
indicator_audit.user:
For each extracted ITEM, look it up in the PAGE TEXT and give a verdict:
CORRECT (the value is printed for that row and year), WRONG_VALUE, WRONG_YEAR,
CORRECTLY_NULL (the indicator is really not printed) or WRONGLY_NULL (it is printed).
Give the value you see in the table, or null, and one sentence of reason.
{% for it in items %}ITEM {{ it.field }}: value={{ it.value }} year={{ it.year }} page={{ it.page }} row="{{ it.row_label }}" reason="{{ it.reason }}"
{% endfor %}
PAGE TEXT:
{{ text }}

time_series.system: You turn IMF statistical tables into data. Copy numbers exactly; never fill gaps.
time_series.user:
From the table text below, return the rows listed, one value per year shown in the table header.
Use null where the table prints "..." or nothing. Keep the units of the table.
Rows: {{ rows | join("; ") }}.
TABLE (PDF page {{ page }}):
{{ text }}

rag_answer.system: You answer questions about an IMF staff report using only the numbered passages supplied. If the passages do not contain the answer, say so plainly and do not guess.

rag_judge.system: You grade answers produced by a retrieval system over an IMF report. You are strict.

query_variants.system: You help a search engine find passages in an IMF staff report.
query_variants.user:
QUESTION: {{ question }}
1. Rewrite the question {{ n }} times with different wording an IMF economist might use (other terms, more specific).
2. Write a short passage (60 to 90 words) in the style of an IMF staff report that would answer the question.
   Invent nothing you would present as fact elsewhere: it is used only as a search probe.
